## Overview

Project-R is the strategic independent commercial project under the SSCCS initiative. It explores new approaches to data storage, structure, and access for agentic computing environments—spanning hardware-software co-design, new abstractions for persistent state, and interfaces that bridge local and distributed computing.

The project follows an open-core model: the foundational infrastructure remains open, while specific commercial applications and hardware are developed as separate ventures. Currently in its early MVP phase, Project-R is advancing core infrastructure, hardware integration, and application design. The technology roadmap spans multiple delivery phases, from software validation to physical product.

## Contact

For inquiries, research collaboration, or investment opportunities, contact [project-r@ssccs.org](mailto:project-r@ssccs.org) or [contact@ssccs.org](mailto:contact@ssccs.org). A one-pager and further technical details are available upon request.
